Let  
\[
T(m,n)=\frac{m^2 n}{3^m(n3^m+m3^n)}.
\]
Swapping \(m\) and \(n\),
\[
T(n,m)=\frac{mn^2}{3^n(n3^m+m3^n)}.
\]
Thus
\[
T(m,n)+T(n,m)
=\frac{m^2n3^n+mn^23^m}{3^{m+n}(n3^m+m3^n)}
=\frac{mn(m3^n+n3^m)}{3^{m+n}(n3^m+m3^n)}
=\frac{mn}{3^{m+n}}.
\]
Therefore,
\[
S=\frac12\sum_{m=1}^\infty\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{mn}{3^{m+n}}
=\frac12\left(\sum_{m=1}^\infty \frac{m}{3^m}\right)^2.
\]
Since
\[
\sum_{m=1}^\infty \frac{m}{3^m}=\frac{3}{4},
\]
we get
\[
S=\frac12\left(\frac34\right)^2=\frac{9}{32}=0.28125.
\]
